criteria.reason: 明确说明目标价值满足 Bellman 不动点方程。
criteria.evidence_quote: The desired value solves a Bellman fixed-point equation.

criteria.reason: 说明折扣小于1时 Bellman 映射在 sup 范数下收缩。
criteria.evidence_quote: For discount below one the Bellman map shrinks sup-norm distances by at most gamma.

criteria.reason: 说明折扣接近1会削弱收缩并减慢收敛。
criteria.evidence_quote: A discount closer to one weakens this contraction and usually slows convergence.

criteria.reason: 说明经典表格结论使用有限状态和动作集。
criteria.evidence_quote: The classical tabular statement uses finite state and action sets.

criteria.reason: 说明异步方案仍需足够覆盖相关更新。
criteria.evidence_quote: Asynchronous schemes still need sufficient coverage of the relevant updates.

criteria.reason: 说明模型不准确时收敛到该不准确模型的解。
criteria.evidence_quote: An inaccurate transition or reward model yields a solution to that inaccurate model.

criteria.reason: 说明价值近似或策略评估截断会引入额外误差。
criteria.evidence_quote: Approximation of the value or truncation of policy evaluation adds further error.

criteria.reason: 说明不能直接套用于未折扣继续任务或变化环境。
criteria.evidence_quote: Do not apply this guarantee unchanged to undiscounted continuing tasks or a changing environment.
